title: A night in Can Gio
summary: Leave Ho Chi Minh City early for the Bình Khánh ferry, give the creek a half day at Vàm Sát, and eat at Hàng Dương after that gate closes. Sleep in the beach town. The whale temple is the next morning. The salt pans are a different dawn, and only in December–May.

days.title: Ferry, the creek, and Hàng Dương
days.body: Start early. Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km; Tuổi Trẻ prints about 2 hours. The ferry itself is about 10–15 minutes, and a holiday queue on the approach can eat the morning. Vàm Sát is open 8:00–17:00. The Sac Forest gate on the tourism page is 7:30–17:30, a different desk. After 17:00 the evening is Hàng Dương, then about 50 m of sand. Sleep in xã Cần Giờ.

days.title: The temple, then the ferry back
days.body: Lăng Ông is under an hour on an ordinary morning. Hours and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival. The salt morning is a different day, December–May, and it starts at dawn. Then the same ferry back to Ho Chi Minh City. The September 2026 story still had the ferry as the crossing.

stops.name: Bình Khánh ferry
stops.note: About 10–15 minutes on the water, about 1.2 km on the Soài Rạp. Door to door is about 1 hour 30 minutes on Visit HCMC and about 2 hours in Tuổi Trẻ. A holiday queue ran nearly 2 hours on 30 April 2026. Walk or bicycle 3,000 VND and a motorbike 8,000 from 18 March 2026. A car fare and a ferry clock are check on arrival.

approach.note: Nguyễn Văn Linh, then Huỳnh Tấn Phát, to the ferry. A motorbike is also the mode the tourism page describes. A hire price was not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Vàm Sát
stops.note: 120 minutes is the cap on the wooden boat to Đầm Dơi. The operator calls the road-gate visit a half day and does not print a minute count for the whole gate. Road gate 60,000 VND, shuttle included, 8:00–17:00 every day. Visit HCMC prints the canoe leg from 270,000 to 895,000 VND. The operator’s canoe table runs from 1,075,000 for one person to 270,000 from nineteen.

approach.note: Along đường Rừng Sác to cầu Dần Xây or the road gate. Minutes from the beach town were not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Hàng Dương and the sand
stops.note: About 30–40 minutes is the 2019 cook-to-order wait on a busy day. The row uses 40, the top of that range, not a clock for the whole evening. The sand is about 50 m from the market. One seller that year said she sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00. That clock is one stall. A stall price was not printed. Check on arrival.

approach.note: A walk if you are already in the beach town. Minutes from Vàm Sát were not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Lăng Ông
stops.note: The visit is under an hour outside festival days. No tighter clock was printed, and hours and a fee were not printed. Check on arrival. The sea rite is a festival morning, at 10:00 on the culture department’s page and at 9:00 in the 2025 city story.

approach.note: In the beach town, xã Cần Giờ. The culture department’s page still says thị trấn Cần Thạnh.

seoTitle: A night in Can Gio — ferry, creek, and Hàng Dương
seoDescription: Two days from Ho Chi Minh City: the Bình Khánh ferry, a half day at Vàm Sát, Hàng Dương after 17:00, and the whale temple the next morning. Sleep in town.
